## Important: Read before submitting

> **New contributors:** Please open or comment on an issue **before** submitting a
> PR to discuss the change you'd like to make. **Do not open a PR** until
> one of the project members confirms that a PR is desired. This helps us
> align on approach and avoids wasted effort on changes we may not be able
> to merge. Please only create a PR once one of the project maintainers
> agrees on your outlined approach.
>
> PRs of contributors who are not vouched for are automatically closed. Regular
> contributors are added to the vouch list.
>
> For LLM-generated changes, we prefer that you write your prompt in an issue
> over a PR with LLM-generated changes.
>
> When submitting a PR:
>
> - The PR description must be human-written.
> - Documentation must be human-written.
> - Comments in the code must be human-written.
>
> We require human-written descriptions and comments because it requires a
> PR submitter to understand and be responsible for the code that they submit.
> We require human-written documentation because LLM-generated documentation
> is typically not misaligned with human preferences in information density,
> tone, and purpose.
